name: You're Digging In Me
source:
In attending an art gallery premier, you crosses paths with renowned artist, Miko Kasihra. Miko is quick to ask you to be her muse, but there's a strange familiarity in her eyes, and you can't shake the thought that there's something awfully wrong.

[From [url=https://lavendeerstudios.itch.io/youre-digging-in-me]itch.io[/url]]
